name: Naze Ano Ko wa Hatarakanai no ka
original_name: 何故あの娘は働かないのか
source:
"I want to protect her from the harshness of the world!" 

Some might call him nosey, but Sou Natsumi (protagonist) was a giver.
First he met a girl living out of a cardboard box at the convenience store; then a bickering hard-to-please illustrator at the park; and then an obsessive gamer who went from co-op raids to real life friendship.
Always one to offer help, Sou ended up devoting his whole summer to the girls, each beautiful, but also antisocial, quirky, moochy and weird.

* Hikikomori x NEET x Online Gaming Addict

Look after these quirky girls, you softie. A comedic adventure novel for otaku with lots of empathy...
or just to tease out the naughty rewards from their young, supple bodies! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE130750.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“我要保护她免受这个世界的残酷！” 

有些人可能会说他爱管闲事，但夏美壮介（主角）是一个付出者。
首先，他在便利店遇到了一个住在纸箱里的女孩；然后是公园里争吵不休、难以取悦的插画家；然后是一名沉迷的游戏玩家，从合作突袭变成了现实生活中的友谊。
总是乐于提供帮助的苏最终把整个夏天都奉献给了这些女孩，每个女孩都很漂亮，但也反社会、古怪、调皮和怪异。

* 蛰居族x NEET x网络游戏迷

照顾这些古怪的女孩，你这个软蛋。一部充满同理心的宅男喜剧冒险小说…
或者只是为了从他们年轻、柔软的身体中挑逗顽皮的奖励！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE130750.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
